usage: CodeScene code health rules for this repository. third_party/ holds pinned upstream distributions (see docs/EMBEDDED_ASSETS.md) that are copied verbatim or reproducibly bundled and never edited here, so function and module size heuristics are disabled for them.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: A text command-line interface: its API and helpers take command names, help texts and command lines, which are strings by nature. Wrapping them in structs only to lower the ratio would make the public API (terminal.command(name, help, handler)) harder to read.

Minified esbuild output of the sources next to it, checked in so that the bootstrap and package resolver need no Node.js at consumption time. It is regenerated by tools/developer/build.mjs --refresh-bootstrap and verified against src/developer/bundles.json, never edited by hand; the readable sources are analysed instead.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: The store implements the webfront.developer.* bridge callbacks, whose identifiers, project paths, offsets and flags arrive as primitives from the browser. Wrapping them in types only to lower the ratio would obscure the bridge contract.
